bullets: Fixed pull request and issue shows not playing on github.com. GitHub changed the markup of the Open / Merged / Closed badge, so Footlit could not tell when a pull request was opened, merged or closed, or when an issue was closed.
Opening a pull request now waits for the new page to finish loading before celebrating, and the debug log says why a show was skipped.
Added tests that use GitHub's current markup.

Fixed repo created, release published, pull request opened and fork shows not playing. Version 1.0.1 only accepted classic form posts, but several GitHub pages submit through script, so those shows were silently skipped.
The activity log can no longer hold up a show if the background worker is slow to answer.
Added tests that mimic script-driven GitHub forms.
Fixed animation cleanup and recovery after waiting in a hidden tab.
Improved event detection to avoid celebrations for cancelled creation flows and repeated deletion banners.
Serialized activity-log writes so events from multiple tabs are retained.
Improved reduced-motion handling, keyboard focus, and feedback when settings cannot be saved.
Simplified the website and added a click-to-play demonstration video.
Connected the approved Firefox Add-ons listing on the website.
**Eleven events** in four groups: repo created / deleted / forked; pull request opened / merged / closed; checks passed / failed / site or deploy live; release published / issue closed.
**Six themes**, each with applause, farewell and alarm versions and its own copy per event: Marquee, Terminal, Mission Control, Pixel Arcade, Web Crawler, Quiet.
Per-event theme override, show length, appearance, reduced-motion handling, Quiet mode.
Popup: theme tiles, all eleven events with a Rehearse button and an on/off switch each, a quiet-mode notice, and an out-of-date-tab notice with a Reload button.
Settings page: sticky navigation, live-preview dock that stays on screen, first-run welcome, activity log, collapsible help, reset.
Detectors only react to transitions seen in a live tab; verified against fixtures (positive and negative cases). Isolated from each other so one failure cannot affect the rest.
Firefox build (its manifest declares that no data is collected), store zips, generated store screenshots and promo tiles, privacy policy and listing copy.
Test suites: detectors and handshake (38 cases), theme matrix (6 themes x 11 events, reduced motion, narrow window).
notes: Known gaps: detectors for repo create/delete/fork, release, Pages and the PR merge-box wording are written from documented behaviour and fixtures and have not yet been confirmed on live GitHub; no sound; stars and terminal pushes are not detected.
